questions.question: What house-elf tries to keep Harry from coming back to Hogwarts?
questions.note: He serves the Malfoys. He blocks the barrier at King's Cross and bewitches a Bludger, trying to send Harry home.

questions.question: What does Harry hide in the diary so that Lucius ends up giving it to Dobby?
questions.note: Clothes free a house-elf. Lucius shoves the diary back at Dobby and the sock comes with it. Dobby is free.

questions.question: What object does Tom Riddle use to possess Ginny?
questions.note: Lucius slips it into Ginny's cauldron at Flourish and Blotts. Harry later destroys it with a basilisk fang. It was a Horcrux.

questions.question: What do the letters of the name Tom Marvolo Riddle spell?
questions.note: He rearranges them in midair in the Chamber. Tom Riddle is Voldemort's birth name.

questions.question: What monster lives in the Chamber of Secrets?
questions.note: Salazar Slytherin's serpent. It moves through the castle plumbing. Spiders flee from it.

questions.question: What happens to someone who sees the basilisk only in a reflection?
questions.note: Looking it in the eye kills. Mrs. Norris, Colin, and Hermione see it indirectly and are only petrified. Moaning Myrtle looked straight at it.

questions.question: What is the name for the ability to talk to snakes?
questions.note: Harry speaks it without having learned it. The school takes that as proof he is the Heir of Slytherin.

questions.question: What phoenix comes to Harry in the Chamber and brings the Sorting Hat?
questions.note: Dumbledore's phoenix. He also pecks out the basilisk's eyes.

questions.question: What weapon comes out of the Sorting Hat for Harry?
questions.note: Only a true Gryffindor can pull it out. Harry drives it through the roof of the basilisk's mouth.

questions.question: What heals the basilisk venom in Harry's arm?
questions.note: Phoenix tears are the only known cure for basilisk venom. A fang had broken off in Harry's arm.
